title: Ordering Lunch to Go
summaryZh: 上班族到餐廳點外帶午餐，選擇配菜、飲料和付款方式。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hi, can I order lunch to go?
sentences.zh: 你好，我可以點外帶午餐嗎？
sentences.note: to go 表示外帶，在餐廳點餐時很常用。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Of course. What would you like?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I'd like the chicken rice, please.
sentences.note: I'd like 是 I would like 的縮寫，比 I want 更客氣。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Would you like soup or salad with that?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Salad, please. Can I have the dressing on the side?
sentences.zh: 沙拉，謝謝。沙拉醬可以另外放嗎？
sentences.note: on the side 表示另外盛裝，不要直接淋上去。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Sure. Would you like a drink?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yes, one iced tea with no sugar.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Would you like a small or a large one?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That's all, thanks. How much is it?
sentences.zh: 就這些，謝謝。總共多少錢？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: It is two hundred and twenty dollars.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.note: pay by card 表示用信用卡或金融卡付款。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes. Your order will be ready in ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 可以。您的餐點會在十分鐘後準備好。

questions.q: What main dish does the customer order?
How does the customer want the iced tea?
When will the order be ready?
